about: Open steps and Tick all and complete: the Todo widget's Rust (crates/todo/src/steps.rs) and the app's TypeScript (src/modules/todo/notes.ts) run the same cases (todo-steps.test.ts). open: unticked Checklist items; ticked: the notes after Tick all. known_gaps are written down, not run: the Rust port reads lines, the app reads a Markdown tree, and they differ on these.

a bare box is not a step

known_gaps: A first line indented by a tab (or four spaces) with nothing before it is an indented code block in the app, and a step in the Rust port.
A fence opened inside a list item or a quote is only recognised at the start of a line in the Rust port.
Checklist-looking lines inside an HTML block.
